indicator.name: Households with durable wall material
indicator.description: Share of conventional households whose dominant wall material is classified as durable under the published 2019 KPHC Atlas definition: concrete/concrete blocks/precast wall, stone with lime/cement, bricks, timber, or prefabricated panels.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS 2019 KPHC Volume IV Table 2.13 + KPHC Atlas H.4 durability definition
indicator.expected_availability_note: Derived transparently for all 47 counties by summing the five published durable wall categories. Census indicator; county only; no lower-level inheritance.

observations.source_table: Table 2.13 — Percentage Distribution of Conventional Households by Dominant Wall Material of Main Dwelling Unit, Area of Residence, County and Sub-County
observations.notes: Transparent category aggregation within the same county geography: Durable wall material is the sum of Concrete/Concrete blocks/Precast wall, Stone with lime/Cement, Bricks, Timber, and Prefabricated panels. Source category shares are rounded to one decimal place; result retained at one decimal. National published durable-wall anchor is 51.3%. No interpolation or geographic inheritance.
